topic: Smart Beta, Quant Funds and other Non-Traditional Index Funds
source_evidence: In addition, these funds may have limited performance histories. It may not be clear how they will perform under different market conditions.
question: Why can a non-traditional index fund’s limited performance history make its behavior harder to assess?
answer: A short or limited performance history may not show how the fund will perform across different market conditions, so its behavior in those conditions can be uncertain.
